title.en: Repealing Sections 3, 4 and 5 of Presidential Decree No. 1745 Dated November 10, 1980, as Amended
title.orig: Repealing Sections 3, 4 and 5 of Presidential Decree No. 1745 Dated November 10, 1980, as Amended

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 EO_00912_1983_html.txt

text.en:
The privileges granted to persons under Sections 3, 4 and 5 of Presidential Decree No. 1745 as
amended are hereby terminated; provided that, persons who have surrendered their unlicensed firearms,
ammunition or explosives as of the effectivity of this order shall continue to enjoy the privileges granted under
the aforementioned Sections of Presidential Decree No. 1745.

This Executive Order takes effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila this 27th day of September in the Year of Our Lord Nineteen Hundred and
Eighty-Three.
